realign_hit_to_structure: realign a PDB seqres hit sequence to the actual mmCIF structure sequence using query to hit mapping
remap_to_struc_seq: remap the query to hit mapping to match the actual structure sequence with gap handling
handle_alignment_error: handle AlignmentError exceptions when PDB seqres and mmCIF sequences cannot be aligned
review_realign_hit_to_structure: review the realign_hit_to_structure function to understand how it remaps query residues to structure residues
summarize_template_realign: summarize the template_realign module which realigns PDB seqres sequences to actual CIF structure sequences
